Use case: stylized-concept. ONE tall PORTRAIT 2:3 full-body LEFT SIDE PROFILE facing screen LEFT. Image 1 = proportion calibrated FRONT OF CORE, sole authority for body length, width, exact armor and relaxed pose. Image 2 = approved-source-derived head normal/mask turnaround, authority for head projections only. Image 3 = original core armor details only. Draw the same robot as Image 1 rotated exactly ninety degrees to its left profile, no 3/4.
Copy the calibrated FRONT'S main anatomical heights, proportions and pose exactly, especially its long thighs and long shins. Head must remain normally tall. Use the FRONT image as the SOLE BODY PROPORTION authority, not a short stocky model sheet. Register positions as a single rigid camera turn: soles to hips about 59% of skull-top-to-floor, knees roughly between long thighs and long calves, ankles well below knees. Width changes with view; physical lengths do not. No foreshortening, crouch or lunge. Include full horn and soles with 5% margin, one whole robot only, no captions or text, clean white background and crisp cel mechanical linework.
Navy torso and basic shoulder plates with ivory/gold border and red recess, red abdomen, separate skirt pieces, long ivory thighs, ivory/navy long shin armor, round gold knee and ankle mechanisms, broad navy boots with gold toes. Two normal black articulated hands, same source forearm cuffs. NO weapons, wing fan, gun, drill, shield, launcher pod or long booster.
Head uses reference Image 2 TOP ROW NORMAL state with mouth line for CORE, BOTTOM ROW CLOSED BATTLE MASK for FULL. It has exactly FIVE gold crown pieces: thick upward curved central horn with tiny backward notch, two long inner slender antennae and two shorter outer ones. Plus ONE thin crimson sagittal fin. From true left side this red fin shows its broad triangle rooted along top of navy helmet, oriented rearward. From rear only its THIN red centerline EDGE is visible, and the taller GOLD center horn must also be visible above it. Keep gold circular ear housings and normal tall helmet. Never put face, eye visor, cheek front vents or mouthplate on the REAR.
Use NORMAL FACE from Image 2 top middle for this core: subtle mouth line, visible nose, ivory jaw and red chin. Tall head on visible neck, no compressed skull. Chest louvre and emblem are on front surface facing LEFT so they are mostly edge-on; don't move them to shoulder or broad side. The near shoulder armor retains its red recessed outer port, circular shoulder pivot, and layered navy/ivory/gold side contour. Back is a modest navy spine and two empty mounting sockets, no giant added backpack. Near arm naturally hangs alongside thigh, not blocking all knee definition. Profile boot points LEFT, heel RIGHT. Same long thigh and shin lengths as calibrated front, same physical feet. Far leg and arm may be naturally occluded, not extra limbs. True side drawing, complete source armor.
